text: Download BrochureBOOK UNITGalleryTrump International Hotel & Tower Dubai Dubai | UAETrump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the Middle East's first and only Trump-branded address, developed by DarGlobal on Sheikh Zayed Road at the entrance to Downtown Dubai. The development combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in one building. Units span 109 to 722 sqm across one- to three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, with sea or Burj Khalifa views from every unit.PROPERTY TYPEBranded Hotel & Residential TowerUNIT TYPE1, 2, 3 Bedroom Apartments & 4 Bedroom Duplex PenthousesSTATUSUnder DevelopmentAREA (SQFT)764 - 7,720FEATURINGThe highest pool in the worldChallenge Everything. Stop At Nothing.Step inside. Look around. This is what winning looks like. Residences & penthouses with soaring ceilings and bespoke finishes. Every inch, a statement of dominance. Overlook the shimmering skyline, the grandeur of Burj Khalifa or the limitless sea. These are the headquarters for the ambitions of visionaries, disruptors, and game-changers. And you’re next.View All ImagesKEY FEATURESThe Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai brings together three iconic worlds in one address: a five-star hotel, a members-only club, and private residences, each with its own state-of-the-art amenities.Trump International Hotel & TowerA five-star luxury hotel, joining the legacy of Trump organization most iconic hotels. Featuring fine dining, world-class entertainment, and true luxury at every turn.The Trump, Members-Only ClubThe Trump Members-Only Club brings together wellness, business, and the timeless atmosphere of a classic private club. Access is limited to members only through an annual fee, with residents receiving priority access.The Trump ResidencesFeaturing 1, 2, & 3-bedroom apartments and 4-bedroom penthouses, the residences dominate the skyline — with every unit offering a view. Residents also enjoy exclusive access to the highest outdoor pool in the world.AMENITIES OF THE TRUMP RESIDENCESThe following amenities are reserved exclusively for residents. Residents can also apply for membership to the Trump Members-Only Club to access its iconic spaces and experience the full lifestyle.Rooftop infinity pool, the highest in the worldState of the art gymOwners loungeKids play areaAt the heart of it allLocated on Sheikh zayed road, right at the entrance of downtown, you are connected to it all without the congestion. Giving you direct access to Downtown, Dubai Mall, and the Dubai Fountains.To activate drag with keyboard, press Alt + Enter. Once in keyboard drag state, use the arrow keys to move the marker. To complete the drag, press the Enter key. To cancel, press Escape.Trump International Hotel & Tower DubaiDubai, UAE[phone]Frequently Asked QuestionsWhat is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.What is the Trump Members-Only Club?The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.What amenities are exclusive to residents of the Trump Residences?Residents have exclusive access to the world's highest rooftop infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, an owners lounge, and a children's play area. Membership to the Trump Members-Only Club is available separately for access to the wider lifestyle facilities within the building.Is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai a good investment?The project sits in one of Dubai's highest-demand corridors, combining a globally recognised brand, a world-record amenity, and direct Downtown proximity. Branded residences in Dubai have historically commanded rental premiums over comparable unbranded units; buyers should seek independent advice on investment suitability.How does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai differ from other luxury towers in Dubai?It is the only development in the Middle East to combine a Trump five-star hotel, a residents-only world-record infinity pool, and a private members club under one address. The hotel-residential structure gives owners access to hotel-grade services alongside private ownership.How do I register interest or enquire about buying at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?Prospective buyers can register interest, download the project brochure, or book a private viewing through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.Show moreRegister Your InterestDiscover exclusive luxury real estate and investment opportunities with DarGlobalPlease provide your details to register interest.Register Interest.
